div.head: Mirce 2
div.ab: Ðonne byð cyninges anfeald wergild syx þegena wergyld be Myrcna lage, þæt is XXX þusend sceatta, þæt bið ealles CXX punda.
Regis simplum weregildum est sex thainorum weregildum in Mircenorum laga, hoc est XXX milia sceatta, hoc est totaliter CXX libr.
Ðonne bið cynges anfeald wergild six þegna wer be Myrcna laga, þæt is XXX þusend sceatta, 7 þæt bið ealles CXX punda.
Then a king's simple wergild is is the wergild of six thegns by the law of the Mercians, namely 30,000 sceattas, which is 120 pounds in all.
According to the law of the Mercians, then, the king's individual wergild is the wergild of six thegns, that is, thirty thousand sceattas, which is one hundred and twenty pounds in all.
Ferner ist des Königs einfaches Wergeld: Wer(geld hlq) von 6 Thegnas nach Mercier-Recht, das heisst 30 000 Skat, und das ist im ganzen 120 Pfund.
Further, the king's single wergild is the wer(gild, hlq) of 6 thegns by Mercian law, that is 30,000 sceattas, and that is 120 pounds in all.
